name: cowling_linear
title: Nonradial perturbations in Cowling, derived from the action
description: Linearization (l generic, m = 0, factor (r/R)^l extracted, Legendre eliminated) of KG, radial and angular momentum and baryon conservation with a frozen metric.

(8a) momento radial.ref: derived from the action in Cowling
